title: Responsive Design with Media Queries
description: Learn to build responsive websites using media queries to adapt layouts to various screen sizes and devices.

lessons.title: Introduction to Responsive Design
lessons.content: Responsive design ensures your website looks good on all devices by adapting layout, content, and styles to screen size.

lessons.title: What Are Media Queries?
lessons.content: Media queries apply CSS rules based on device characteristics like width, height, orientation, resolution, etc.

lessons.title: Mobile-First vs Desktop-First Design
lessons.content: Mobile-first design writes default styles for small screens and uses min-width queries for larger devices. Desktop-first does the opposite.
